prompt:
Create one 2×2 sprite atlas for this Daggerfall Unity pixel-art talking portrait. Use only the supplied prepared grid as the exact reference for identity, expression, framing, selected guarded eye geometry, palette, and pose order. Preserve the unmistakable skeptical brow asymmetry and the original face, hair, and pixel-cluster style.

Cells in row-major order with no labels or gutters: top-left LEFT gaze OPEN; top-right RIGHT gaze OPEN; bottom-left LEFT gaze HALF; bottom-right RIGHT gaze HALF. Every cell is a complete, identically framed upper crop with 64:35 proportions.

Only shift both compact amber irises laterally together by about one native pixel per direction, keeping natural convergence. Keep dark shaded whites and small dark amber irises with only tiny warm source-like glints. No cream or white bands, no bright flash, no enlarged iris, no widening the eye opening. Keep brows and upper face fixed. For HALF cells, the upper lid must descend to cover part of each iris; preserve the fixed lower lid and cheek at their exact source positions. Do not move or repaint the lower lids or cheeks. Match the narrow source aperture and muted brown-olive pixel palette.

No text, labels, border, gutters, extra panels, added objects, or watermark. Transparent background false; include the full portrait crop in each cell.
